newsitem.title: USA: Cost of building Gowanus Tunnel pegged at $2.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Cost of building Gowanus Tunnel pegged at $2.5 bln.

text.p: A study by the Regional Plan Association on Tuesday recommended building a new Gowanus Tunnel in southern Brooklyn instead of trying to reconstruct the present expressway, which has torn neighborhoods apart.
"The Gowanus is an outmoded, 1940s transportation facility that has reached the end of its useful life," the Association said in summary of its study.
On a preliminary basis, it estimated that a full, new tunnel would cost $1.5 billion to $2.5 billion. The alternative, reconstructing the expressway, would require spending up to $1 billion.

However, the Regional Plan Association said that the state Department of Transportation (DOT) did appeared likely to resist the proposal. "But NYSDOT has always regarded reconstruction of the Gowanus Elevated as the only feasible course."
A spokesman for the state department was not immediately available to comment.

The association added that while the DOT has cut the amount of time needed to renovate the expressway, which is a four-mile stretch of Interstate 278 that runs parallel to the south Brooklyn waterfront, it still would take six years. The roadway carries about 50 million vehicles a year.
